_comment: Instruction-phase RSA: forward/backward direction regressor + order-independent
('set') instruction models. Everything already estimated elsewhere is fitted
ONLY as part of a combo, never again as a single model.
WHAT IS FITTED AS A SINGLE MODEL
- the order-independent set models (they are new)
- `direction` on its own, as the reference for reading every partial below
The ordered *_rew_instr models and the *_rew execution models are listed in
selected_models only so combos can use them; their single_model_scopes are [].
THE SET MODELS. d = 1 - |multiset overlap of the first k instructed locations| / k.
A location revealed twice counts twice, keeping the 0/0.25/0.5/0.75/1 scale of
the ordered models; at k=1 this reduces exactly to A_rew_instr. Hypothesis:
subjects hold the revealed locations in working memory as a set, without the
sequence position.
THERE IS NO k=1 SET MODEL. With one location per condition order cannot matter,
so A_rew_instr_unordered would be arithmetically identical to A_rew_instr
(verified: the whole 20x20 RDM matches, r = 1.0000) -- both as a single and in
a +direction combo. It is omitted rather than run as a duplicate. It would also
have been constant across task halves, so it could never have been fitted there.
WHY DIRECTION IS IN THE ACROSS COMBOS. Across halves `direction` is exactly
orthogonal to every set model (r = 0.0000), so on its own it would be neutral.
But it correlates about -0.55 with the execution models there, so once
execution is in the design the partial correlation of direction with the set
model is +0.37 (ABC) and +0.45 (ABCD). It is NOT conditionally neutral, and
leaving it out would let execution absorb direction-driven variance.
K=4 CAVEAT. The full multiset is reversal-invariant, so ABCD_rew_instr_unordered
cannot distinguish instructed from executed ORDER -- read it as a 'locations
this task uses' model. It is NOT equal to ABCD_rew (r ~ 0.18), which is why
every across combo carries its ordered execution counterpart.
Reuses the data_RDMs_glmbase_<glm>_<mask> cache (keyed on regression_version +
searchlight_mask, not on name_of_RSA): no searchlight is recomputed.
plot_example_data_RDM is OFF: this config fits 37 maps, and the plotting path
opens a figure per model per scope without closing them (matplotlib warns past
20). Across 33 subjects x 11 epochs that is wasted memory on the cluster, and
the model RDMs were already checked once locally.
